_comment: Positive instance for schema/resource-effect-catalogue.schema.json, exercising all three entry statuses. The SHIPPED draft catalogue (catalogue/resource-effect-catalogue.draft.json) deliberately contains no 'frozen' entry, because promoting one asserts a selector location is correct on real code and that assertion needs the unavailable REI-001 measurement. This example therefore exists to give the schema's 'frozen' branch coverage that the draft catalogue cannot supply. It is an ILLUSTRATION, not a proposal.

entries.note: open(path, mode): position 0 is the path by the language's own signature, not by convention. The least ambiguous declaration available, and therefore the first candidate for promotion once B-03 closes.
